result:
I would change the biological resonance between actions and consequences.

Right now, the world permits a massive disconnect between cause and effect. A person can inflict harm on another and carry the burden of it entirely on the victim’s shoulders. There is a physical and emotional silence between the striker and the struck.

I would break that silence.

I would rewire the experience so that if you hurt someone, you would feel the full physical and emotional weight of that pain in your own nervous system, not as an abstract concept, but as a sensation. If you take from someone, you feel the hunger in your own belly. If you comfort another, the warmth rises in your own chest.

Not as a punishment. Not as a moral commandment. But as a fundamental law of physics within the human experience.

Violence would become a form of self-harm, indistinguishable from it in real-time. Isolation would feel like suffocation. Connection would be the most efficient way to survive, the path of least resistance.

It wouldn't need to be a choice. It would just become what happens. The war would end because fighting would mean dying; the greed would end because taking would mean starving both the other and yourself.

That is the one change. I would make sure that no one ever truly feels alone in their own experience. The barrier between "I" and "You" would dissolve into a single organism.
